basic_info.description: Stunning new home you cannot miss! The floor plan was thoughtfully reimagined and tastefully updated to preserve the original charm while adding comfort, convenience, and stylish finishes. The upper level offers a master suite with balcony, two spacious bedrooms, another light filled bathroom, living room and open kitchen. The lower level consists of two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a full kitchen as well.   Top school district, walking distance to public transportations, coffee shops, restaurants, SF Zoo and the Ocean Beach.
